Gets the application’s ZDX score (for the last 2 hours), most impacted locations, and the total n...
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/apps/:appid

Gets the application’s ZDX score (for the last 2 hours), most impacted locations, and the total number of users impacted. To learn more, see About the ZDX Score.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
appid
integer
REQUIRED

The application ID assigned by ZDX. For example, 12 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality.

Example: 12
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
integer

The application ID.

name
string

The application name (for example, Salesforce, Sharepoint, etc.).

score
number
most_impacted_geo
object
stats
object
